  exact ne_of_gt ((φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right (fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left h _).symm.le
